adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.schema.ts`, the server schema is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())`, which allows an empty array and does not enforce uniqueness or any max size. In the UI, `AddGuestsDialog` adds an extra client-side constraint via `.refine(...)` to require uniqueness. The handler (`addGuests.handler.ts`) partially compensates by filtering duplicates/existing attendees and rejecting when `uniqueGuests.length === 0`, but that’s not the same as enforcing uniqueness/non-empty at the schema boundary, so the client/server validation contracts can diverge for non-UI callers.
